title: Replay a saved-basis rebuild receipt only while the planning baseline still belongs to its recorded cut
outcome: Replay a saved-basis rebuild receipt only while the planning baseline still belongs to its recorded cut
acceptance: A repeated saved-basis rebuild by the same actor and session replays its old receipt only when the current planning baseline still belongs to the recorded cut; otherwise it compares afresh and records a new cut

A behaviour test reproduces the scenario (rebuild from T carrying A over local B, a headless folder import restores B without changing T or the head, the same rebuild repeated) and shows the second rebuild leaves a current cut so the next ordinary import succeeds instead of refusing "baseline advanced"
